project_type: Full-stack manga translator - React/TypeScript frontend + Python FastAPI backend (BFF pattern)
build_system: Vite + npm for frontend, pip/uvicorn for backend
test_framework: Vitest for frontend, pytest for backend
build_command: npm run typecheck && npm run build (from project root)
test_command: npm run typecheck (no tests required per instructions)
verification_instructions: Run `npm run typecheck && npm run build` from project root. Both must pass clean.
setup_instructions: npm install in project root; pip install -r requirements.txt in backend/
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. No Docker needed.
contribution_requirements: No tests required. Keep typecheck + build passing. Create feature branch, commit, push, open PR against main.
key_patterns: Backend providers: each in backend/app/providers/<name>.py exporting async functions. BYOK: X-Byok-<Provider> headers resolved in deps.py KeyResolver. Frontend stores: zustand with persist middleware. Settings modals: features/settings/<Provider>SettingsModal.tsx. EngineId enum shared between frontend types.ts and backend schemas/common.py. Pipeline: frontend calls pipelineApi.ts -> backend router -> pipeline.py orchestrator -> providers.
directory_structure: Root: App.tsx, types.ts, store/, features/, services/, components/. Backend: backend/app/ with providers/, routers/, schemas/, services/, config.py, deps.py, main.py.
